high_level_description: This image captures a serene sunset view from inside a room with a large window. The window frame is dark brown, and the window itself is open, allowing a clear view of the outside scene. Through the window, we see the iconic London Eye Ferris wheel prominently featured on the left side of the image. The sky is painted with hues of pink, orange, and yellow, indicating that it is either sunrise or sunset. The cityscape in the background includes various buildings, some of which appear to be historic structures, possibly including Big Ben, as suggested by its distinctive clock tower.
